walk.environment:
Build: the read-only worktree /tmp/claude-0/rewalk2/tree at 9eb10528. git status was clean before and after, and nothing in it was edited. I ran the app from that folder with /tmp/claude-0/rewalk2/out/T/launch.py, which drops HTTP(S)_PROXY, ALL_PROXY, OO_DB_PASSPHRASE, OO_DB_PLAINTEXT and OO_NO_SCHEDULER, sets PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, and runs `python -c "from src.api.main import main; main()"` with cwd set to the tree. Port 9627.

Data: a FRESH seed, not a copy. I ran `scripts/ui_clickthrough_seed.py --mini` (24 synthetic articles) from the tree into /tmp/claude-0/rewalk2/out/T/data with OO_DB_PASSPHRASE='walk-pass-2026' and OO_DB_PLAINTEXT unset. The database header is ciphertext (first bytes 225 002 273 ]), not 'SQLite format 3'. Because the folder is new, its briefing_cache.json was written by this build, so no refresh or removal was needed.

Boot 1 (PID 24133): a normal boot with neither variable set. /api/system/lock-state read {state:'locked'} at boot and 'unlocked-encrypted' after the real #pw / #btn-unlock form. The boot engaged airplane mode by itself (/api/system/network online:false; no POST was needed). It served T1-T7, T9, T10, the 375 px pass, and the probes for T-1 to T-9. The only 4xx/5xx in its log is my own curl of /api/system/network while it was locked (503, expected).

Boot 2 (PID 895): OO_NO_SCHEDULER=1, which is what step T8 prescribes. It started online with the scheduler not running and the wiki lane active:false (reason not-started). It was unlocked through the same form, and after about 33 s of T8 measurements the /tasks plane click took it offline. I then stopped it by PID (SIGTERM from the script) to watch the /tasks health dot turn red (T-6). Boot 1 was also stopped by PID. I used no pkill or killall.

Airplane and egress: an lsof monitor sampled each server PID's internet sockets once a second for the whole life of both boots. egress-boot1.log and egress-boot2.log show 0 non-loopback peers. It samples, so a sub-second connection could slip through. The one consent popup (T4) was opened, read, screenshotted and cancelled with 'Stay offline'. 'Go online' was never pressed.

Browser: Playwright sync with Chromium /opt/pw-browsers/chromium, headless, args --disable-background-networking --disable-component-update --no-proxy-server, proxy variables removed. Viewports 1440x950 (en, with fr/ar/zh through the real top-bar #lang-switch, live and cold) and 375x812 (en and ar; /tasks also in zh). A fresh context's default theme is 'system', which renders as light.

Everything is in /tmp/claude-0/rewalk2/out/T/:
- Scripts: walk1.py (T1-T7, T9, T10), walk2.py (T8, plus the T-6 red dot), walk375.py, probe_i18n.py (T-1, T-2, T-3, T-7), probe_tasks.py (T-5, T-6, T-8, T-9), probe_busy.py (T-4).
- Output: a matching .json for each script, screenshots in shots/, and server-boot1/2.log.

steps.evidence:
Opened with #tm-open while offline; /api/scheduler/activity has online:false. The /tasks plane is filled, colour rgb(217,108,108) (= --err #d96c6c). Its title is exactly 'Offline (airplane mode) — click to go online in the app; you'll be asked to confirm first.', the summary reads 'Airplane mode' and health 'healthy'. Schedule shows 'paused — airplane mode' (shots/T-T5-tasks-offline-en.png, T-T5-tasks-schedule-en.png).

Live switches without a reload give the exact fr, ar and zh titles, 'Mode avion' / 'وضع الطيران' / '飞行模式', and translated tab titles (all expected_*_ok true). ar mirrors (dir=rtl). The first 100 ms sample after <html lang> changes already shows the new language for the title, the state, the health and the tab title (walk1.json T5 samples). The same values held after a reload and a 7 s wait.

steps.locales: en (fr/ar/zh hovers and toasts also checked)

steps.evidence: 150 sequential fetch('/api/articles?limit=1') calls from the app page: ok 150, refused 0, no other status, 1.6 s (walk1.json T7).

OO_NO_SCHEDULER=1 boot: /api/system/network online:true, scheduler running=false, wiki_lane active=false (not-started).

Online state:
- The app plane is hollow (fill none, not off), and its styled bubble reads exactly 'Online — click to go offline (airplane mode); every new network request will be refused.'
- The /tasks plane is hollow with the same title, summary 'Idle', health 'healthy'.
- Live fr, ar and zh titles, 'Idle' and health are exact (expected_title_ok, idle_ok and health_ok all true), and no title says 'stops all collection'. They flip about 100 ms after the lang change.

ONE click on the /tasks plane:
- after about 200 ms the plane is filled and red (rgb(192,57,43)), the title is the offline text, the summary reads 'Airplane mode', and #tm-conn reads 'Offline — every new network request is refused. One in-flight request may finish.';
- it stayed that way for all 12 s (60 samples);
- /api/system/network online:false;
- the app tab repainted to filled/offline with no consent popup.

The egress monitor saw 0 non-loopback peers. shots/T-T8-*.png, walk2.json.

No collection pass can run without egress: /api/scheduler/activity has collect_perf null, so there is no process_budget. toggleVitals() opens the in-app window, whose System subtab has no 'COLLECTION SPEED' block, which is the correct no-pass state (shots/T-T9-vitals-system-en.png).
/api/jobs/history?limit=100 has 0 runs and no crawl_delay_deferred, and there is no host_schedule.json in the data folder. Not observed on this corpus.

walk.summary:
Row T passes on build 9eb10528 for everything a sandbox can reach, and all 9 of its re-walk items (T-1 to T-9) are fixed.

The setup was a fresh encrypted --mini seed, locked at boot and unlocked through the real form. The app stayed in airplane mode except for T8's prescribed OO_NO_SCHEDULER=1 boot, which went offline through its own /tasks click after about 33 s. Both boots showed zero non-loopback sockets.

Steps:
- T1-T8 pass in en, fr, ar and zh:
  - the coach buttons are identical in Ink, Paper, Solar and Mint, and the coach re-anchors on RTL;
  - the consent popup opened only through the coach and was cancelled;
  - the /tasks airplane titles and states are exact and flip about 100 ms after a live switch;
  - the gauge and the Settings slider are one control, with no consent popup;
  - the loopback rate limit gave 150 of 150 ok;
  - both states were seen on the /tasks plane.
- The 375 px pass passes.
- T9 and T10 are not measurable here: no pass runs without egress, and there is no crawl history.

Items:
- T-1: the gauge hover is correct in ar, zh and en after fr clicks, both live and cold.
- T-2: the corpus-tier hover follows every switch, and the MutationObserver shows no revert.
- T-3: the Collection toggle and the 'Most recent' empty line repaint after a switch from cold fr.
- T-4: no '(server busy)' stamp on an idle server, with verified_current:true at cache ages of 241-375 s.
- T-5: no Mode row in either Schedule renderer.
- T-6: the /tasks dot is green when healthy and red after the server was stopped.
- T-7: the AI pill hover is keyed and fully in the UI language.
- T-8: /tasks follows the app theme, including a live change.
- T-9: the heading is one line at 1440 px in en, fr and zh.

No JS page errors, no HTTP responses of 400 or more from the pages, and no undefined/NaN/null text. The only console errors are 10 net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED on the app tab after I deliberately stopped the server for the T-6 red-dot check. One incidental item: at 375 px the Most recent tag select clips its closing parenthesis.
